newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU grants aid to UK coal industry.
newsitem.headline: EU grants aid to UK coal industry.

text.p: The European Commission authorized on Wednesday a total of 371 million pounds in aid for the 1997 and 1998 financial years to the privatised British coal industry.

The aid aims to ensure that the economic viability of the British coal industry is not threatened by liabilities inherited from before the privatisation, including environmental damage and exceptional social welfare benefits to be paid to redundant workers, it said in a statement.

"The UK government was compelled, before the privatisation of the British Coal Corporation, to meet obligations arising from the restructuring, rationalisation and modernisation of the UK coal industry which cannot be considered related to current production," it said. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
